summary: Page 21, "Local Happenings" community-notes column, Lakewood Area subsection. Target item: Miss Emily Rodriquez of 124 Fulton Ave., Lakewood, entering a Carmelite convent in New York on June 12, is noted as author of a book based on her life titled "Out of Darkness to Light," to be published in the July issue of Bronze Thrills magazine. Rest of the page is unrelated general local news (Garden State Parkway baby club, UAW/CIO labor split, police blotter, obituaries) with no other Black-press content.
